meta.name: understand-knowledge
meta.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将LLM知识库转化为交互式知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要从大量文本中提取实体和关系并可视化
copy.tagline_en: Transform LLM knowledge base into interactive knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract entities and relationships from large text and visualize them

howto.what: 分析一个 Karpathy 模式的 LLM 知识库（包含原始资料、维基 markdown 文件和配置文件），提取实体、隐含关系和主题聚类，生成交互式知识图谱。
howto.when: 当用户提供一个符合 Karpathy 模式的维基目录（包含 index.md 和多个带 wikilinks 的 .md 文件）时触发。

say.text: 分析我的 LLM 维基知识库，生成知识图谱。
say.note: Claude 会检测目录结构并启动分析流程。

say.text: 帮我理解这个 Karpathy 模式的知识库。
say.note: Claude 会扫描、分析并生成交互式图谱。

howto.what_en: Analyzes a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base (raw sources, wiki markdown, schema file) and generates an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a directory that matches the Karpathy wiki pattern (contains index.md and multiple .md files with wikilinks).

say_en.text: Analyze my LLM wiki knowledge base and generate a knowledge graph.
say_en.note: Claude will detect the directory structure and start the analysis pipeline.

say_en.text: Help me understand this Karpathy-pattern knowledge base.
say_en.note: Claude will scan, analyze, and produce an interactive graph.
